entry.title: New: Resolution 411 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE ISLAND OF HAWAI‘I YMCA FOR REIMBURSEMENT OF EXPENSES RELATING TO ITS NEW HORIZONS WINTER BREAK DAY CAMP MURAL PROJECT

Transfers $4,850 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 3)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 411-24 - 01/24/24
